plan.title: RFQ Template Disabled on Other Stage

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create flow is valid.
Create the technical stage and RFQ stage required by the case.
Configure the RFQ stage first, where the template is selected.
Select the first available RFQ template; this establishes the template that should be unavailable on the other stage.
Move to the other stage where the previously selected template should be disabled.
Assert that the other stage's template picker renders available templates; the catalog cannot assert the previously selected template's disabled state or tooltip.
